rules.alternatives: Proof of maintenance of NCCPA certification instead of the 50 hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal after initial licensure or reinstatement: at least 8 hours of Category 1 pharmacology; exempt from the other 42 hours.
rules.audit_note: Board may impose a $100 penalty per missing CE credit. Keep implicit bias certificates up to 6 years; proof only if audited.

topics.who: All PAs: Category 1 education on pharmacology topics, within the 50 hours
All health care practitioners renewing after Apr 1, 2026: attest to an implicit bias and structural racism training (Health Occupations Article §1-225)

rules.notes: PA licenses (prefix C) expire June 30 of odd years. Renewal fee $401 includes the $26 MHCC assessment.
